en: I want a Bellsprout. Would you trade me one for my Onix?
A Bellsprout! Great! Rocky is tough, but he's gentle. Take good care of him.
That isn't a Bellsprout. It's a Bellsprout I'm after.
Oh. Please come back if you find a Bellsprout.
Bellsprout and I train in Sprout Tower every day. I hope Rocky is doing well.
